title: Customer cancels before restaurant acceptance
facts_text: I placed and paid for my order a few minutes ago. The restaurant has not accepted it, and preparation has not started. I am requesting cancellation because I no longer want the order.
request: Please cancel the order and refund the full amount, including delivery and service fees.

strict.reason: The restaurant has not accepted the order, so the policy permits cancellation for a full refund.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The base cancellation condition is met; the late-item exception is not needed.

ambiguous.reason: The order is eligible under the explicit pre-acceptance cancellation rule; the late-item discretion does not affect this decision.
